units: <cite ref="Shabbat 105a:13">Sabb. 105ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>שני בתי נירין בנירין</he>, v. <cite ref="N00787">preced.</cite>) <he>תרתי בבת נ׳ וחדא בנ׳</he> Ms. M. a. Rashi (ed. <he>בבתי</he>, early ed. <he>בבי</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he passes a thread twice around the cross-rod and once around the cross-beam (jugum).

<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:2">Ib. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ ברקא</he> a white twisted cord.—Pl. <he>נִירַיָּא</he>. Y. ib. XIII, beg. 14ᵃ (expl. <he>בנירין</he>, v. supra) <he>נ׳</he> the two cross-rods (the liciatorium and the jugum).
